stories.title: Where is your turkey right now? If it's in your freezer, act now!
stories.summary: It takes days for turkeys to thaw from being in the freezer. How to do a quicker cold-water thaw.

stories.title: High Point police chase suspect Benjamin Pyrtle jailed after hospital release
stories.summary: Pyrtle was arrested Sunday and is being held in the Guilford County jail without bond

stories.title: Greensboro police investigating after shooting victim shows up at Drawbridge Parkway medical center
stories.summary: Anyone with information is asked to call Greensboro/Guilford Crime Stoppers at 336-373-1000.

stories.title: Man sentenced after his 8-year-old son accidentally shot, killed himself in Winston-Salem
stories.summary: A man has been sentenced to 1-2 years in prison after his 8-year-old son shot himself with his gun at their Winston-Salem home in 2025.

stories.title: USPS Operation Santa: Allows kids to write letters, their wish list is adopted & the Post Office delivers the gifts
stories.summary: The program is 100 years old, and through the program's evolution, Santa gets a few helpers. How you can write a letter or adopt a letter.

stories.title: Two men charged in connection with deadly September shooting at Club O in Greensboro
stories.summary: Two people have been charged in connection with the deadly Club O shooting on West Market Street that killed Marvin Allen Watlington and injured five others.

stories.title: Wake Forest's leading rusher Ty Clark III out for remainder of season
stories.summary: Head coach Jake Dickert announced Monday that Clark will miss the rest of the season. He leads the Demon Deacons with 591 rushing yards and 11 touchdowns.

stories.title: Lincoln Elementary surprises teacher as she begins second battle with breast cancer
stories.summary: Students and staff surprised a beloved second-grade teacher with a show of support as she prepares to begin treatment for an aggressive recurrence of breast cancer

stories.title: High Point University students provide 100 Thanksgiving meals to local families
stories.summary: High Point University students are continuing a holiday tradition by providing meals to families across the community.

stories.title: Winston-Salem man arrested on kidnapping, sexual offense charges
stories.summary: A Winston-Salem man faces four charges after an investigation involving a missing 15-year-old girl.

stories.title: High Point woman charged with purposely burning her disabled child with an iron
stories.summary: A High Point woman faces a felony charge after allegedly burning her disabled son with an iron.

stories.title: NC Highway Patrol Mourns Loss of Caisson Horse Nellie
stories.summary: The NC State Highway Patrol mourns the loss of a longtime Caisson Unit horse who died while assisting with funeral honors for Sgt. Devin James.
